title: Basic English — Course 2, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 1

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Where is the new refill station?
tasks.audioText: The college sustainability group has started a project to reduce single-use plastic. A water refill station has been installed beside the main canteen, and students can collect a reusable bottle from the student office on Thursday. The group will compare the amount of plastic waste before and after the project. Volunteers should record observations for two weeks.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. How long should volunteers record observations?

tasks.prompt: A local college introduced a reusable container scheme after a survey showed that most lunchtime waste came from disposable packaging. The canteen now offers a small discount to students who bring their own containers. Staff also placed clear signs near the serving area. After one term, the amount of disposable packaging had fallen, although the college plans to collect more data before deciding whether to expand the scheme. Reading 1. What encouraged the college to introduce the scheme?
options: A survey showed that disposable packaging caused most lunchtime waste

tasks.prompt: Why will the college collect more data?
options: To make a better-informed decision about expanding the scheme

tasks.prompt: If the college had collected feedback earlier, it ___ the scheme sooner.
Choose TWO reliable ways to reduce plastic waste.
Materials that can be processed and used again are ___.
You are writing to the canteen manager with a suggestion. Which opening is most appropriate?
options: I demand that you change everything immediately.
I would like to suggest introducing a reusable-container discount.
I do not care what you decide.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of reducing plastic waste in a logical order.
options: Introduce the change and explain it
Identify the main source of waste
Measure the results and review the plan
correctOrder: Identify the main source of waste
Introduce the change and explain it
Measure the results and review the plan

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words giving your opinion on how a college can reduce plastic waste. Support your view with two reasons and one practical example.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); appropriate vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
